input:
CURRENT SCENE:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

ITEMS:

[I72] 【一天，很久很久以前】   correction: 一天，很久很久以前 → 很久很久以前的一天   strength: error
  checker's note: time expression needs this word order
  rule card (fixed_expressions, Vocabulary): Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use the established expression <correct>, not the literal/nonstandard combination <wrong>.  Her terms: 从 + Place, 制定规定, 自然规律, Subj.算是Obj., 只/不过/才(+num.) + 而已
  her past correction: [一个天时候→有一天]
  her past correction: 每天[就是→都是]这样
  her past correction: 但我没想到他[可能很久以前→很久以前可能]并不是这样

[I73] 【孟子】和他妈妈住在中国   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧的妈妈跟孟子一起住在中国 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在一起 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧跟妈妈一起住在西安 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I74] 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜【^】   correction: ∅ → 祖先   strength: error
  checker's note: 祭拜 needs an object here
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈每天从早到晚[-做]工作
  her past correction: 孟母[一看→看到]孟子祭拜 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: [她→孟母]跟孟子搬家去墓地做祭拜 — her note: “她” is ambiguous

[I75] 很多墓地【得】我祭拜   correction: 得 → 需要   strength: error
  checker's note: 得 is not natural in this statement
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement
  her past correction: 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction: 他们一起常常[去祭拜，会去墓地→去墓地祭拜]
  her past correction: 不是去墓地就是[+去]教堂

[I76] 很多墓地得【我】祭拜   correction: 我 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 我 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction: 他们一起常常[去祭拜，会去墓地→去墓地祭拜]
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜

[I77] 所以我们得【去】很多不同的地方   correction: 去 → 搬到   strength: error
  checker's note: moving house requires 搬到, not 去
  rule card (cause_result_soyi, Coherence: connectors): Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the following event is not a result of the preceding clause, so 所以 is not appropriate; use <connector> / delete it.  Her terms: 这样, 结果, 后来
  her past correction: 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 我们要[搬家再一次→再搬一次家] — her note: 再V. + Num. + MW. + N.

items.explanation: 一天，很久很久以前 → 很久很久以前的一天: use the established time expression 很久很久以前的一天, not this word order.
孟子 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly, for example as 一个叫孟子的孩子.
祭拜 needs an object here. Add 祖先: 祭拜祖先.
很多墓地需要祭拜 is more natural here. 得 is not used this way in this statement.
我 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
It would be more natural to say 搬到很多不同的地方, because this means moving house rather than simply going somewhere.
